title: The Night of the Braided Waterfalls
description: At the mountain village’s winter festival, three waterfalls braid together above the basin. Villagers bring their lanterns to watch the braid loosen into mist.
alt: Three icy waterfalls twist together between snowy cliffs above a misty pool. Three cloaked figures watch from a ledge beside a lantern.
pairing: A winter mountain festival × waterfalls that braid themselves
